name: TDF Papeete Pic Rouge Data Center
notes: TDF announced inauguration of its first French Polynesia data center at Pic Rouge, Papeete, on 2020-10-16; Baxtel lists TDF as a French Polynesia data center provider with 0.3 MW.

name: Tahiti Nui Fortress Papenoo Data Center
notes: ONATi/OPT official page describes Tahiti Nui Fortress as a secure data center in Papenoo with 24/7 supervision, redundant power and cooling, two 630 kVA generators, fire protection, and ISO 27001 certification; IT capacity not publicly stated.

name: Kyndryl Papeete Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Kyndryl Papeete, French Polynesia data center; Kyndryl's own locations page confirms a French Polynesia office in Papeete, but no primary technical facility details were found.
